justification: Both surfaces appear to show anthropomorphic or creature-like forms with splayed limbs spread across a single continuous curved field, which is about as generic a correspondence as one can have. A depicts modelled, rounded human bodies in energetic interlocking poses with arms raised and hands grasping, while B is a dense, flat linear composition dominated by a large symmetrical fan/plant-like motif with fine incised scrollwork and small emblematic details, sharing neither specific motifs nor the same figural conventions.
